page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 24 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes 35 MB of L3 cache.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. It achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1282.13 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.03 GB/sec. In application-specific tests, the server processes 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec.

A key hardware tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for data persistence. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation provides predictable compute performance without resource contention, making it a stable choice for workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. This instance is suited for general-purpose applications, database operations, software compilation, and medium-scale web serving.
